wang_trap_depth.text: The formation of the MoSe2/WSe2 heterobilayer results in a moire potential landscape consisting of quantum-dot or quantum-wire like local potential wells with depth of the order of 10s-100 meV [27,28].

wang_trap_gas.text: We assign the exciton density of n_t-g ~1-5x10^11 cm^-2 to the transition from moire trapped excitons to the free exciton gas due to dipolar repulsion [17].

wang_window.text: Our results indicate that the free interlayer exciton picture, widely assumed in the literature, only exists in the narrow density range around 10^11 ~ 10^12 cm^-2.
